scope: Uniform supplementary reasoning-conclusion audit of all 60 reasoning observations across all six completed configurations. Visible final conclusions are compared with frozen references; generated code is never executed and hidden reasoning is never credited. Original grades remain intact.
policy: One unambiguous final result is compared with the static reference using the frozen numeric tolerance. Multiple differing JSON conclusions remain manual review. Reasoning r04 is directly checked against the explicit set-inclusion/exclusion premises. Whole-response JSON shape/fences are checked separately from numeric/logical correctness. Mathematical reasoning can be correct while the original case fails formatting or tool behavior.
